wording.engine_summary: Runs an installed Windows 11 Arm desktop on BridgeVM's own Hypervisor.framework VMM with persistent storage, display/input, dynamic resolution, network, audio, clipboard and folder integration, TPM/Secure Boot workflows, snapshots, window Coherence verbs and experimental 3D. Release-blocking evidence remains open; known defects are disclosed below.
wording.machine_contract: QEMU virt-compatible guest contract with documented deviations

criteria.title: Cold boot reliability
criteria.statement: At least 9 of 10 cold boots report stage4_pass=1 AND firstboot_fresh=1 in firstboot-stage.txt.
criteria.measured: PROVEN 2026-08-10 at 0f02579: the product-default Apple in-kernel-GIC fresh-firstboot P1 gate passed 10/10, above the fixed 9/10 threshold. Every independent APFS clone recorded stage4_pass=1, firstboot_fresh=1, last_stage=stage4, three SYSTEM_RESET transitions, clean SYSTEM_OFF and zero stalls; all ten firstboot hashes were distinct. Historical record: eight instrumented 5-boot soaks (14/40 aggregate) with owning-thread GIC reads at every terminal stall. Two failure shapes fully characterized: UEFI (PPI pending at GICR, CPU interface open/idle, never taken) and kernel (CNTV_CTL ISTATUS=0 with CVAL millions of ticks past -- the fire never forms). Historical correction 2026-08-11: RPR=0x10/AP1R0 with banked GICR_ISACTIVER0=0 did not prove an empty active set because shared SPI/MSI active state lives in distributor GICD_ISACTIVER*. Clearing the APR changed readback to rpr=0xff but was not a proven-safe correction and did not resume delivery; exact run 20260811-140847 later reached a Hypervisor.framework EOI-order trap after such a clear, so the mutation was removed. Every host lever tried and measured: unmask, CVAL rewrites, mask pulse, forced ISPENDR0 (delivers -- boot dies anyway; falsified as cure), ICC APR clear. ICH list registers unreadable (EL2 view unavailable). Defect isolated to Apple's in-kernel GICv3/vtimer under hv_vcpus_exit pressure; no public API re-arms forwarding. Apple Feedback draft ready (a1-apple-feedback-draft-20260806.md); remaining host option: relocate guest wake onto an owned device interrupt. 2026-08-07: EL2 avenue measured (strictly worse -- parks before first serial byte with zero exits/window) and wake-relocation closed by inference (waking the CPU is not the gap: 69k re-entries did not help, and even delivered timer interrupts did not save the boot). Every host-side avenue is now measured or closed by measurement-backed inference; the remaining path is Apple (Feedback draft ready, owner files). 2026-08-08 CONTROL EXPERIMENT: QEMU 11.0.2 accel=hvf on the SAME host boots the SAME canonical image 10/10 to the image's own bvagent READY (18-24s/boot, clean agent-driven poweroffs) -- QEMU links zero hv_gic_* symbols and emulates the GICv3 in userspace, driving hv_vcpu_set_pending_interrupt per run. Host kernel, vtimer surface and guest image exonerated; the defect is specific to the in-kernel GICv3. A host-side exit that does not wait on Apple now exists: swap the full-VM path to the codebase's userspace GICv3 (probe_mmio gic_* + platform/apple/firmware_irq.rs pattern). Evidence: a1-qemu-userspace-gic-control-20260808.md. 2026-08-08 USERSPACE-GIC SWAP LANDED: full userspace GICv3 (userspace_gic/ + usgic_bridge) behind BRIDGEVM_USERSPACE_GIC=1; zero hv_gic_* calls. Seven guest-contract findings fixed (PFR0.GIC advertise, WAKER storage-only, Group1 reset, PMCCNTR fastfail, edge-latched vtimer PPI w/ EOI-driven unmask, CNTPCT passthrough, SMP routing). Soak: 10/10 installed boots to BVAGENT READY (82-87s) with agent-driven PSCI SYSTEM_OFF, vs 14/40 on the in-kernel GIC. The A1 mechanism is absent by construction. Remaining for the criterion: the fresh-firstboot p1 gate (9/10 stage4_pass+fresh) on this configuration. Evidence: a1-userspace-gic-swap-20260808.md. Same-day scope note: usgic carried A15 to PROVEN (100/100), but venus 3D on usgic is not healthy -- first a real viogpu3d bug (D1 EXECUTE on pageable PAGE-section code at DISPATCH_LEVEL; DPE=1 stops it), then a vkCreateInstance wedge (CTX_CREATE + attach loop, zero SUBMIT_3D; hv_gic runs SUBMIT_3D immediately and A2 re-passes 58.82). MSI-X delivery verified in the ring; divergence is later in the venus fence/event chain. hv_gic stays default until resolved. That historical open note is superseded for A1 by the 2026-08-10 product-default in-kernel-GIC 10/10 fresh-firstboot gate.

criteria.title: Vulkan title frame rate
criteria.statement: A real Vulkan title reports guest-side samples>0 AND p50>=30 FPS.
criteria.measured: PROVEN 2026-08-08: verify-vulkan-title-fps.sh PASS x3 (samples/p50: 2511/58.82, 2528/58.82, 2531/58.82; source=setframebuf-intervals) on canonical-a2-staged-20260807 with venus_icd_loaded from the DriverStore, real content (cube.iso), foreground window, 45s windows. Final instrument defect: this PPSSPP binary never emits 'fps:' lines at any loglevel (measured 3/5/6, 7.9MB D-level log) -- the gate now derives per-frame samples from the title's own sceDisplaySetFrameBuf DEBUG lines (each flip interval = one frame time). The Vulkan path was never slow (~59 FPS p50 through venus); what looked like a 'Vulkan-startup wedge' was A1-class session mortality AROUND a working gate (1 of 4 final-day sessions still parked). History: 2026-08-06 instrument chain repair (bd31835..2ab575d); 2026-08-07 11 attempts 0 samples all A1-parked; retraction of an invalid falsification (6b8df9d) after finding the wrapper scrubbed BRIDGEVM_AGENT_WAKE_MS.

criteria.title: D3D11 title frame rate
criteria.statement: A real D3D11 title reports guest-side samples>0 AND p50>=30 FPS.
criteria.measured: PROVEN 2026-08-12 by live campaign 20260812-173200-91503-26516 on exact head 31368a1fc55abc8f3421d5b11b2e537c4f96a6f2: run_count=3, passes=3, failures=0, threshold_fps=30.0, fps_samples=[2633, 5275, 5369], fps_p50=[250.0, 62.5, 62.5], receipt SHA-256 8430c7d682c81330da3c2d969eb57ddd1c381c2dc59edc2fe094657a9f93a21e. Each run reported identity status=PASS against sealed hashes for the PPSSPP executable, title-local DXVK d3d11.dll and dxgi.dll, the installed DriverStore Venus ICD, the canonical image and the content. Reaching this required fixing a MoltenVK MSL emission defect that wrote an undeclared gl_CullDistance member (worked around at the PPSSPP layer for Venus adapters), making the identity probe report every module sharing a base name, pinning the Venus ICD expectation to the driver the sealed image installs, and anchoring the measurement window to the first presented frame. No threshold, sampler, renderer, timeout or the 3/3 policy was relaxed.

criteria.title: Dynamic resize
criteria.statement: After a window resize the guest-reported resolution equals the request.
criteria.measured: 1600x900, 1920x1080 and 1280x720 all PASS with a matching final SET_SCANOUT. Re-run 2026-08-17 on net-live-20260724: the viogpu3d adapter is present but refused with CM_PROB_UNSIGNED_DRIVER (code 52), and bcdedit /set testsigning on is blocked by Secure Boot policy inside the guest, so no display exists that can adopt a resize on this image. The 1.0 install flow must provision SB-off or pre-enable testsigning; the host-side plumbing needs no change (a8-resize-secure-boot-wall-20260817.md).

criteria.title: In-app install
criteria.statement: ISO installation and installed-disk import are reachable from the UI; 3D driver injection remains unavailable until both product flows consume a BridgeVM-verified signed kernel-policy package snapshot and a retained clean-machine flow passes.
criteria.measured: OPEN 2026-08-26: a historical developer package reached a 3D desktop, but that did not prove a safe product installation path. Test-signed kernel packages conflict with Microsoft Secure Boot policy, and no BridgeVM-owned verifier binds a signed kernel-policy package snapshot to both install and import. Main a5b0e63b05e3b269382a7d8801c7ced342ccb620 therefore removes every product injection authorization surface and offers only 3D-off install/import. The criterion stays open until the signed-provenance verifier and a retained clean-machine run exist.
criteria.known_defect: Windows-HVF 3D driver injection is unavailable for install and import: signed kernel-policy provenance and a clean-machine installation flow have not been proven. The product exposes only 3D-off install/import.

criteria.title: Standalone app
criteria.statement: The app in /Applications boots to 3D while the source repository is renamed away.
criteria.measured: Deep codesign plus bundled Hypervisor entitlement verified; booted with the repository renamed to bridgevm.a10-hidden; device_status=0xf, 3D commands=649, create3d=826, flush=533.

criteria.title: No regression
criteria.statement: Workspace, Venus library, probe example, Swift suites, formatting, clippy, structural budgets and documentation gates all pass at the exact current release head, with a retained exact-SHA receipt.
criteria.measured: Re-proven 2026-08-30 at exact tested code head 49f2c8fdebb1c5c4bc445840fb7923afddfd099c. The complete local scripts/check-project.sh passed, including workspace and Venus tests, the probe examples, Rust formatting and clippy policy, structural budgets, documentation gates, Swift build/tests and all XCTest-shim suites. GitHub-hosted CI run 33331915348 passed the repository matrix, including the Rust 1.98 latest-stable advisory, and Security and quality run 33331878973 passed fuzz corpus smoke, Loom, graphics-claim, live-gate and supply-chain policy checks. The independent BridgeVmPcPkg ACPI/SMBIOS DXE consumer also built reproducibly from pinned EDK2 as a 12,288-byte AArch64 development driver with SHA-256 01f555aec886cf241f277c53ac2bf57d38fd064a8ae4b6508f4f4897802efccc; this is a module-build result, not a firmware or Windows boot claim. A separate exact-head live single-run probe at d7a9d191b8acd37939a94e5ef2f14cceb83d8d13 showed an EL1 guest reading boot-info v1 and following its RSDP to XSDT. A9 remains OPEN. B4 is separately PROVEN by exact-head Studio t8 job 20260830-134316-74417-14894: fixed N=20 landed 20/20 with zero rendering/package regressions and p95 243 ms.

criteria.title: Secure SMCCC TRNG
criteria.statement: Guest TRNG_RND_32/64 are served only by the host OS CSPRNG; no exit-count, time, PID or constant-derived fallback exists, and provider failure returns NO_ENTROPY.
criteria.measured: The protocol lives in bridgevm_hvf::smccc_trng over SecRandomCopyBytes, with one dispatch shared by the primary and secondary loops. 14 tests cover the DEN 0098 register layout, bit masking, request limits, FEATURES discovery and the fail-closed paths; the exit-counter generator and the duplicated probe constants are deleted. Guest-visible behaviour is not yet re-measured on a live boot.

criteria.title: PSCI 1.1 conformance
criteria.statement: CPU_ON and AFFINITY_INFO implement the specified state table, affinity levels and error codes with atomic state transitions.
criteria.measured: State logic lives in bridgevm_hvf::psci with 13 tests covering the CPU_ON table, affinity levels 0-3, cluster aggregation, CPU0, RES1 spellings and invalid targets/levels. CPU_ON reports ON_PENDING for a pending CPU, AFFINITY_INFO reads X2 and searches the whole topology, and the state check and Off->OnPending transition share one critical section. Live 1/2/4-vCPU topology validation is not yet run.

criteria.title: Typed product runtime
criteria.statement: The product app and hvf-runner drive a typed runtime API from a versioned launch manifest instead of executing an example binary through shell.
criteria.measured: PROVEN 2026-08-07 with a GUI-driven session: the packaged BridgeVMControl.app launched a library VM through hvf-runner --launch-spec (log: 'launching through the typed runtime'), the guest booted to BVAGENT READY on the app's shipping device shape (virgl 0x1050, TPM2 TIS on the runtime-owned swtpm with the Keychain-derived key, agent console, evidence surfaces incl. launch-manifest.json), and an agent-console shutdown ended in PSCI SYSTEM_OFF with a clean process exit. Foundation: 24 R1 slices (f545fd0..fbb2fa3) -- typed manifest validation, pre-launch writer leases, env_clear allowlist spawn, run_vm generations with flush+receipt, DeviceSurfaces env parity, supervisor-owned swtpm (key over fd 0, wrong key refused), watchdog-less app mode, runnerArguments() vector pinned by the 188-test suite. Fixed on the way: ad-hoc builds cannot use the data-protection keychain (errSecMissingEntitlement on WRITES only -- the probe must be a real add), so the key store falls back to the login keychain for unentitled builds. Wrapper script remains as the source-checkout fallback only.

criteria.title: Process-recreate reset
criteria.statement: 100 consecutive guest SYSTEM_RESETs each produce a new helper PID, an increasing reset generation, a fresh guest boot marker and 4 online CPUs.
criteria.measured: 2026-08-08 PROVEN on the userspace GICv3 (BRIDGEVM_USERSPACE_GIC=1): CYCLES=100 verify-reset-recreate.sh PASS -- 100 consecutive guest SYSTEM_RESETs, each producing a fresh helper PID (predecessor gone), increasing generation 1..100, fresh agent READY and online_cpus=4; reset.receipt generation 100 with disk+vars flushed. Zero A1 parks in 100 consecutive full boots (~4.7h). Prior in-kernel-GIC best: 8 cycles/13 generations before a UEFI park. Run: reset-recreate-usgic3-151732. Evidence: a15-reset-recreate-100-20260808.md.

criteria.title: Release security and storage hardening
criteria.statement: Release builds launch only bundled signed helpers, verify socket peer UID, hold an exclusive disk/vars lease and use positional atomic disk I/O.
criteria.measured: Overrides: scripts/check-release-overrides.sh inspects compiled objects and reports 4 overrides debug-only, PASS. Bundled signed helper: HelperCodeSignature.swift requires the swtpm helper to share the app team ID, with 10 swift-testing tests. Peer UID: crates/bridgevm-daemon/src/peer_credentials.rs with tests. Exclusive lease: crates/bridgevm-hvf/src/media_lock.rs. Positional atomic disk I/O: every seek+read on a data path is now read_exact_at/write_all_at -- nvme/disk.rs (read, write-back write, and the copy-on-write chunk fault), probe_mmio/virtio_backend.rs, virtio_blk/media_backend.rs and windows_arm/uefi_io.rs, whose write_all_at/read_exact_at were named for positional I/O while seeking. Three tests park the shared file offset at 4096, perform a read, a write-back write and an overlay fault, and require it to still be 4096; falsified by restoring seek+read, which reports the offset moved to 1536. The one remaining seek is in media_lock.rs, rewriting the lock file's holder line, which is not a data path.

criteria.title: Nonblocking provenance-sealed live queue
criteria.statement: Long gates run asynchronously on the Studio local queue with sealed commit/image/vars hashes and no foreground wait beyond 120 seconds.
criteria.measured: The Studio local queue (com.ketchio.bridgevm-live LaunchAgent, StartInterval 60s, no inbound listener and no runner registration) has run 121 completed jobs across tiers t0-t5 plus t1-snapshot and t1-restore-boot, counted from ~/BridgeVM/live-queue/done. Submission returns a job id immediately and never waits. Receipts seal the commit and, for tiers that read one, the image and vars: job 20260805-115614-86173-14911 records disk_sha256 6fef8f980adbc6af1ed41a1934d1ebafd93b8a1b4d2ab9a3f8bd07ae950d9b54 and vars_sha256 d329b5b03cc5673435d3949f1b5b5b2bfe3f4dfe1f6f0b56ca5894f3bce87d3f against the real 64 GiB pair, re-read from the job directory 2026-08-16. The field is disk_sha256; this criterion previously called it image_sha256. Nine defects were found by running the queue rather than by reasoning about it.

criteria.title: Claim consistency
criteria.statement: README, STATUS, core descriptors, CLI and app wording are generated from or checked against this registry, and a deterministic check fails on drift.
criteria.measured: README and STATUS carry generated blocks rendered from this registry and never hand-edited; render-capability-status.py --check fails on any drift between them. The forbidden-claim scan covers whole trees (crates/**/*.rs excluding /target/, apps/macos/Sources/**/*.swift) plus README, STATUS, AGENTS.md, docs/decisions/hvf-windows-engine-strategy.md and the capability matrix prose, replacing a hand-kept six-file list that silently stopped covering anything added or moved. Falsified during the original widening: appending '// Windows beta' to crates/bridgevm-cli/src/main.rs made the check fail; it was not caught before the widening. 2026-08-20 correction: the post-release scan also retires stale 'the product is Engineering Preview' present-tense wording, which had survived in AGENTS.md after the 1.0 promotion. A mechanical promotion guard also refuses to raise product_state while any release-blocking criterion is unproven. Evidence: docs/windows-arm/capability-matrix.md.

criteria.title: Disk safety
criteria.statement: Powered-off snapshot export and restore keep a byte-exact atomic disk plus vars pair under an explicit byte quota.
criteria.measured: Restore-boot proven by live-queue job 20260805-091656-10876-16297 (tier t1-restore-boot, outcome completed, pass true, commit e8eb8b9e3ac7, Mac16,9 / macOS 26.5.2) against the real 64 GiB image: create.txt records disk_bytes 68719476736 and disk_sha256 56b1361282933f2cf3e409604cdc2da81f8c6ad8536de2bdcc472818e204280d. The guest-observed marker goes BV-NO-MARKER before the write, BV-ORIGINAL-1785935910 after the disk is clobbered, and the identical BV-ORIGINAL-1785935910 after restore, so the restore returns state a guest process can read rather than a file that merely hashes correctly. The remaining acceptance items are covered by tier t1-snapshot through scripts/verify-powered-off-snapshot.sh, a different job.

criteria.title: Boot stall rate measured
criteria.statement: Measure and record the boot stall rate with n>=10.
criteria.measured: n=17, 5/17 pass at the time of measurement.

criteria.title: Stall cause isolated
criteria.statement: Name the stall cause by device axis, or record that all four variants behave identically.
criteria.measured: Isolated more precisely than a device bisection: the guest ICD never observes the first Venus ring response, and pass/stall runs diverge at one identical command.

criteria.measured: present health create3d=0 flush=0 ratio=n/a healthy=false threshold=0.10; idle runs fail closed.

criteria.title: Pointer click reliability
criteria.statement: Pointer interaction passes a fixed 20-boot live campaign at 20/20 with p95 visible-response latency <=250 ms.
criteria.measured: PROVEN 2026-08-30. Studio t8 job 20260830-134316-74417-14894 at exact BridgeVM code head e38ba7c9dc252d13977a4e3c69564cc88abb1b35 used sealed input manifest 75caf98b80b95b8e5a7a31f6ed845dcbeaaa409ab7aa2013d1c4f32b84323c5a and driver tree 838fcbe165dbdae0f18fa1cf21b156b0114f49f1041b2df367541413b00aa9f1. Its fixed N=20 independent disk-and-vars lanes landed 20/20 pointer samples with zero rendering/package regressions, no stuck buttons, and nearest-rank p95 visible-response latency 243 ms against the unchanged 250 ms limit. No Illegal resource or context error reported marker appeared in any lane run log or renderer trace. Public receipt SHA-256 is 59d79bce7e20fbd1fdd1facf9898557b9c4562301e168864ac59a8e2b8c4ae80. The package is self-signed and test-mode-only, so this result does not close A9.
